name: Durable Outcome Promotion
description: Outcomes that meet durability criteria are promoted from session scope to project or user scope. Criteria include confidence, recurrence, source authority, and explicit endorsement.
purpose: Elevate high-value outcomes from temporary session context to persistent project or user-level memory, ensuring repeatable benefit without manual curation.
acceptanceCriteria: Durability criteria defined: confidence threshold, min recurrence, source authority score
Promotion targets: user scope (personal), project scope (team-visible)
Promoted outcomes retain full provenance chain
Promotion is reversible — demotion back to session scope
Promotion decisions are logged and auditable
Bulk promotion and rollback are supported
rollback_strategy: Demote all promoted outcomes; restore pre-promotion memory state
recovery_strategy: Re-evaluate promotion criteria from session journals
